content:
laura: Heads-up — sample-app logs aren't carrying request-id through async retries. OTEL shows spans but logs have no trace id. Repro in the sample FastAPI app. Anyone else?

matt: seen that. is this the new async client or the old sync wrapper?

laura: async client. minimal repro: 
```py
async with RedwoodAsyncClient() as c:
    await c.generate(... )
```
logs show no request_id header in handlers when retry kicks in. Also my IDE warns: AsyncClient.__aenter__ typing is Any instead of 'RedwoodAsyncClient' which hides methods.

sophie: are you using structlog + request_id from otel baggage? we map baggage->logging in middleware. maybe baggage not copied into background tasks.

matt: yeah I think asyncio.create_task loses contextvars. retries run via background task.

laura: exact stack: retries in retry.py call `asyncio.create_task(self._do_retry(...))`

ryan: we should use `contextvars.copy_context().run(...)` or in py3.11 use `asyncio.create_task(coro, context=ctx)` pattern. either way we need to preserve the OTEL baggage.

matt: also typing bug: `class RedwoodAsyncClient(AsyncClient): def __aenter__(self) -> Any` -> should be `-> "RedwoodAsyncClient"`. small fix, helps autocompletion.

laura: PR incoming for both: preserve context for retries + fix typing. will include test that asserts request_id appears in logs after retry.

devex-bot: CI queued for PR #4321 — lint + unit tests

sophie: also feature request: can SDK auto-add span attributes like model.name, model.size, quantization to spans? would help ops triage.

matt: +1. file an issue and include suggested attribute names. we'll evaluate impact on payload size.

ryan: assigning to @matt for typing change, @laura for retry/context patch. thanks! :tada:
